PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Desmond crossed out, only one square is left for Agnes that fits her clue ("She was standing in a puddle."). So Agnes (A) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Beatrix is now the only person who can still go in row 4. So Beatrix (B) must be at row 4, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: The victim must share an area with exactly one other person. So Violet (the victim) must be at row 2, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Cedric that fits his clue ("He was in the last column."). So Cedric (C) must be at row 3, column 5. Cross out his row and column. Desmond is the only person in the Campfire with Violet, so Desmond is the murderer!
